title: `default`
description: Documents the value a server or client should assume when an optional parameter is omitted.
question: Is the declared default value preserved at each capture boundary?
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP tool schemas declaring default values.
known_issues: Two framework adapters could not be measured against 2026-07-28, so missing evidence is not a support result.
why: Defaults communicate omission behavior. Losing or changing one can alter calls without changing the visible parameter type.

notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: `McpToolProvider` maps each `inputSchema` into LangChain4j's own `JsonSchemaElement` model (`JsonObjectSchema`, `JsonStringSchema`, `JsonIntegerSchema`, ...), and the `ToolSpecification` AiServices hands the `ChatModel` is built from that model. `JsonIntegerSchema` holds a description only, so `limit.default` is dropped.
